decisions.reason: As a multi-model sports flooring system outside the firm's main trend-led residential focus, it likely has higher carrying costs and by 2022 enough market feedback to justify reallocating resources if traction is not strong.
A mobile arena floor line is a specialized and likely costly option to keep open, and with the firm already holding many adjacent offerings the option value is lower once several years have passed.
This second mobile arena floor line appears especially vulnerable to portfolio pruning because it overlaps with other sports-floor options while serving a narrow segment.
The chevron hardwood parquet fits the firm's stated direction, is close to its core offer, and was presented as a flagship, so the firm would be inclined to continue backing it.
Although a surface finish is not very costly to carry, squash is a narrow niche and after three years the firm would likely drop it if it has not clearly strengthened the sports-floor business.
As a complementary accessory for sports floors, oak skirting is relatively cheap to maintain and can support system sales, so its option value still likely exceeds its carrying cost.
